summary: Learn EIA screening, scoping, impact analysis and mitigation planning. Explore the five-day course and its practical assessment exercises.
lede: Environmental impact assessment training prepares EIA practitioners to screen proposals, scope studies, and connect baseline evidence with likely project effects. The five-day course is for EIA preparers, reviewers, and project planners; it develops skills in baseline study planning, impact significance analysis, alternatives comparison, and mitigation planning. Exercises also cover review and reporting, with introductory GIS-based mapping and digital reporting workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, or use environmental impact assessment outputs in project planning and approval workflows.
prerequisites: Recommended: experience with project planning, environmental work, project review, or permitting. GIS and programming skills are not required.
